bio: There have been some developments at Schwitzer's. In the newly refurbished rooms of the former fine dining restaurant with floor-to-ceiling windows affording views of the park grounds, diners are invited to embark on a culinary adventure that takes its cue from the seasons. Depending on the time of year, varying styles of cuisine are proposed – à la carte or as a three-course surprise set menu. Schwitzer's Hotel am Park has upscale guestrooms....
